migration.title: Migrate from Confluence
migration.intro: Imports spaces, pages and every page version (with original dates, comments and author names) from a Confluence Server/Data Center. Raavi only reads from the source. Imported spaces are visible to you only; grant access afterwards. Start with a dry run to see what would happen.

migration.modeImportHelp: Import — write the spaces and pages into this workspace
migration.urlHelp: Only addresses your system administrator has allowed can be used.
migration.tokenHelp: Used for reading only. It is stored encrypted and erased when the migration ends.

migration.keyMapHelp: One per line: ConfluenceKey=RAAVIKEY. Needed when a key is already used in this workspace.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.noHosts: The administrator of this installation has not allowed any webhook host yet (Raavi:Integrations:AllowedWebhookHosts), so webhooks cannot be created.
webhooks.intro: Raavi calls the address you give with a signed POST when the chosen events happen. The body names the event and the ids involved (space, page, user) — never titles or text. Failed deliveries are retried automatically.
webhooks.name: Name
webhooks.confirmDelete: Delete the webhook “{name}” and its delivery log?
webhooks.secretOnce: Copy this secret now. It is not shown again; if you lose it, create a new one.
webhooks.verify: Every request carries X-Raavi-Signature: t=<unix time>,v1=<hex>. Compute HMAC-SHA256 of "<t>.<raw body>" with the secret and compare; reject old timestamps.

export.title: Data export
export.intro: Download a ZIP archive of the content of this workspace as JSON files (plus the attached files), for backup, audits or moving to another system.
export.i1: Spaces with their current pages: title, hierarchy, labels, the published body, comments and attachments.
export.i2: Tasks, calendar events, databases with their rows, slide decks and whiteboards (JSON, and SVG for boards).
export.i3: A manifest with counts, what was left out, and a list of the people named in the data.
export.n1: Pages you cannot view (restricted pages, private spaces you are not part of).
export.n2: Drafts, archived and deleted content, and page history.
export.n3: Permissions, notification settings, AI and webhook configuration, secrets and sessions.
export.scopeNote: The export contains what you, as the signed-in administrator, may view. A complete dump of the whole workspace is a separate operation for the installation administrator.
export.failed: The export could not be created. Try again later.
export.inProgress: An export of this workspace is already running. Try again in a few minutes.
